title: Three Hour Deadline
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji believed death was inevitable, the shattered turtle shell suddenly emitted a faint glow, as if responding to the call from the depths of his soul—was this the final contingency left by his Chen family ancestors, or the awakening will of the Tianji Record itself?

text.content: Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat soaking his back. That feeling had come again—stronger and more real than ever before. Deep within his soul, an invisible hand seemed to grip him tightly, and excruciating pain spread like tides through his limbs. He looked down at his chest, where a faint crimson mark was slowly emerging, like a death sentence branded onto his soul. "Three hours." An aged yet authoritative voice thundered in his mind, "In three hours, the Eye of Heavenly Way will complete your erasure." Chen Ji bit his lip hard, nails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. Heavenly Fate Value—the foundation supporting all his schemes—was now on the brink of exhaustion.

The crimson mark on his chest emanated scalding heat, each heartbeat feeling like being pierced by a branding iron. Chen Ji forced himself to remain calm, trembling hands pulling out the tattered Tianji Record from his chest. The densely packed text on the yellowed pages was now slowly fading, as if some power was stripping away his ability to foresee. "Heh, the Eye of Heavenly Way..." A mocking arc formed at the corner of Chen Ji's lips, though there was no笑意 in his eyes, "Finally willing to step onto the board yourself?" He had always known this day would come. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been marked by that eye transcending all. He simply hadn't expected it to come so quickly.

dialogue.content: (That voice rang out again, carrying inexorable authority) "Chen family remnant, do you think a single incomplete Tianji Record can defy heaven? You should know better than anyone the fates of all previous prophets."

text.content: The fates of previous prophets? Chen Ji closed his eyes, fragments surfacing in his mind that Mo Xiansheng had once revealed—some went mad and died, some were burned as demons by the world, and others... were buried by their own kin. None met a good end. This was the price of the Tianji Record, this was the curse of foresight. "But I am different from them." Chen Ji's eyes burst open with unprecedented sharpness. From his earliest memories, he had been treated as waste, bullied, mocked, his dignity trampled—yet these humiliations did not crush him. Instead, they forged his steel-like will.

He remembered the scene of his father's death. That down-and-out man, hunted by the sect, gripping young Chen Ji's hand and using his last breath to say: "Ji'er, remember... the Tianji Record chose you not because of your talent, but because of your..." The words were never finished, his father having breathed his last. This sentence had haunted Chen Ji for over a decade. Not talent, not bone quality—what could it be? He had always believed he had calculated everything perfectly, yet now facing the Eye of Heavenly Way's erasure, he felt truly powerless for the first time. The mark on his chest grew more painful, as if reminding him: time was running out.

choice.prompt: The three-hour deadline has been activated, Chen Ji must make a choice. In this life-or-death moment, how will he seek a sliver of survival?

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the chessboard guardian left by Chen family ancestors, knowing all truths about the Tianji Record. Although he only reveals what should be said each time, at this moment of life and death, perhaps key information can be extracted.
choices.visible_reward: May Unlock Hidden Function of Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's Answers May Be Riddles, Wasting Time
choices.process_label: 陈机将意识沉入天机录，试图唤醒沉睡的墨先生

text.content: Chen Ji bit the tip of his tongue, dripping a drop of essence blood onto the Tianji Record's cover. The pages suddenly gleamed with ethereal blue light, and a illusory figure slowly emerged. The complex expression that crossed Mo Xiansheng's aged and authoritative face said: "You've finally encountered a real crisis." His voice was drifting and uncertain, "But what I can tell you remains only what should be said."

choices.description: Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key; her special constitution can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Although Chen Ji has never known where she is, perhaps this can be used to break the Eye of Heavenly Way's lock.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Large Amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: May Completely Escape Tracking of Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian is Controlled by Holy Sect, Reckless Contact May Expose Her Location
choices.process_label: 陈机动用天机录残页最后的力量，试图感应陈念的位置

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, pouring all his spiritual power into the Tianji Record. The text on the fragment flickered wildly, but every vision was like viewing flowers through fog—there were images of Chen Nian, yet her features and location were forever obscured. This was the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, yet it also became his only hope at this moment. In the blurred images, he faintly sensed Chen Nian was sleeping within some secret realm, surrounded by layers of forbidden formations.

choices.text: Go All In, Strike Back Against Heavenly Way
choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Way wants to erase him, he will take the initiative within these three hours, using the forbidden power of the Tianji Record Fragment to forcefully peer into this eye's true form—a life for a life.
choices.visible_reward: If Successful, Will Completely Shatter Eye of Heavenly Way's Chess Game
choices.risk_hint: Success Rate Extremely Low, But Reward May Be Key to Changing Fate
choices.process_label: 陈机疯狂地翻开天机录，试图触及被封印的禁忌页

text.content: Chen Ji violently flipped the Tianji Record to its final page—where there should have been blank space, a line of blood-red ancient script now appeared: "Peer at Heaven with Life, Reverse Heaven's Path." The moment his fingertip touched those words, the entire Servants' Quarters trembled violently, the sky suddenly darkening. The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice rang out again, this time carrying a trace of surprise: "You dare..."

Intense pain spread from his fingertips throughout his entire body. Chen Ji felt as if he had been thrown into a boiling furnace. But he did not retreat; instead, he clenched his teeth and dove deeper into that blank page. Blurred images appeared before his eyes—a colossal eye floating within the endless Void, its depths filled with countless stars and threads of destiny. It was too vast, so vast that Chen Ji could not perceive its full form; it was too powerful, so powerful that merely its gaze made him nearly suffocate.

At that moment, a memory not belonging to Chen Ji suddenly flooded into his mind. It was an ancient altar, countless figures in black robes kneeling and worshipping, offering something to that eye. And standing at the center of the altar was a familiar figure—Chen Ji's father, his father in youth, casting something into the flames with a look of absolute resolve. "So that's it..." Chen Ji suddenly understood, "Father... he knew this day would come long ago." He murmured, a complex light flickering in his eyes. So his "waste" identity all along had been deliberately created by his father as a protective cover.

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice turned ice-cold) "Chen family remnant, your peering ends here." Chen Ji felt his chest heat up; the crimson mark suddenly spread, like a burning brand covering his entire chest. Excruciating pain nearly made him faint, yet he死死 guarded his last thread of consciousness—he could not fall, absolutely not! Three hours, he still had three hours!

choice.prompt: Chen Ji saw his father's secret, but the cost was the Eye of Heavenly Way accelerating the erasure process. The mark on his chest had spread to half his body; he must make a final desperate struggle within the dead end.

choices.text: Use Turtle Shell to Isolate Perception
choices.description: That ancestral turtle shell had protected his father many times in critical moments; perhaps it could temporarily isolate the Eye of Heavenly Way's lock, buying Chen Ji breathing room.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Power Sealed Within Turtle Shell
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily Escape Eye of Heavenly Way's Lock
choices.risk_hint: Turtle Shell's Power is Limited, Only Delaying Time
choices.process_label: 陈机取出贴身的龟甲，将仅剩的天命之力灌注其中

text.content: Chen Ji took out that warm turtle shell from his贴身garment. This was the only memento his father left him, covered with traces of time. He pressed the turtle shell against the spreading crimson mark on his chest—something strange happened. Dense ancient patterns emerged on the turtle shell's surface, repelling the crimson mark and actually forcibly suppressing it back. "It works!" Chen Ji rejoiced in his heart, but he also sensed the power within the turtle shell was being consumed at a terrifying speed.

choices.text: Contact Demon Path Saint Ye Qing
choices.description: Ye Qing possesses Demon Path Mist skills, which can conceal the Tianji Record's aura. Although she is of the Demon Path, Chen Ji had a secret agreement with her; perhaps this was the time for her to fulfill her role.
choices.visible_reward: Use Demon Path Mist to Shield Tianji Record's Aura, Disrupt Eye of Heavenly Way's Tracking
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's Conditions May Be Very Harsh
choices.process_label: 陈机启动与夜清之间的秘密传讯阵法

text.content: Chen Ji bit his finger, drawing a hidden formation in the void. After a moment, a cold female voice rang in his mind: "Chen Ji? You're actually contacting me voluntarily; seems like you've encountered big trouble." Ye Qing's tone carried a hint of amusement, "Go on, what do you want this time?" Chen Ji did not hide, briefly explaining his situation. The communication fell silent for a moment; Ye Qing's voice came again: "Demon Path Mist... doable. But this requires you to答应me one thing."

Just as Chen Ji was considering countermeasures, the turtle shell suddenly emitted a soft hum. He looked down to see the ancient patterns on the turtle shell's surface fading visibly, as if something was being devoured. Chen Ji's heart tightened—the power consumption within the turtle shell was faster than he imagined. At this rate, let alone three hours, he might not last even one hour. "Must find a solution quickly..." he murmured, cold sweat dripping from his forehead.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice carried a rare vulnerability) "Father... what else did you leave behind?" He examined the inner side of the turtle shell, where a line of nearly illegible small characters was carved. Leaning close to discern them carefully, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—it was an incantation, seemingly used to activate some hidden function of the turtle shell. But the text was too blurred; he could only make out a few characters: "Heavenly Fate... Lock... Heart..."

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Heart? These four characters stirred something in Chen Ji's heart. Heavenly Fate Lock Key—his sister Chen Nian was called the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. And now, similar words appeared on the turtle shell. Could there be some connection between the two? Chen Ji closed his eyes, striving to recall his father's dying words. "The Tianji Record chose you not because of your talent, but because of your..." Because of his what? At this moment, the mark on his chest that the turtle shell had temporarily suppressed began to ache faintly again, reminding him time was slipping away.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered hidden incantation clues on the turtle shell, but time was tight. He must decide whether to focus on deciphering the incantation or seek outside help first.

choices.description: The turtle shell is the last memento left by his father; the incantation upon it likely holds the key to breaking the deadlock. Chen Ji decided to invest all his energy into deciphering those blurred characters.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Large Amount of Spiritual Power
choices.visible_reward: May Activate Turtle Shell's True Power
choices.risk_hint: Incantation May Require Specific Conditions to Activate
choices.process_label: 陈机将龟甲凑近眼前，试图用天机录的力量辅助解读

text.content: Chen Ji overlaid the Tianji Record on the turtle shell, attempting to use the Tianji Record's power to decipher the blurred text. Gradually, the turtle shell's surface gleamed faintly, and the hidden text began to become clear: "Control destiny with heart, lock heaven with life. Opportunity lies within heart, heart precedes thought." Chen Ji repeatedly chewed on these sixteen characters, and suddenly understanding dawned in his heart—so the so-called Heavenly Fate Lock Key, what it locked was not another's heavenly fate, but one's own heart!

choices.text: Seek Help from Inner Disciple Senior Fellow
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person who has noticed something off about Chen Ji, and also the most likely person within Tianqing Sect to help him. Although exposing his identity carries great risk, at this moment there was no other choice.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's Trust and Assistance
choices.risk_hint: Whether Su Qingyao Is Willing to Help Remains Unknown
choices.process_label: 陈机冒险激活与苏青瑶之间的秘密传讯

text.content: After the communication connected, Su Qingyao's voice carried suppressed anger: "Chen Ji? Contacting me this late—you'd better have an important enough reason." Chen Ji had no time to explain, simply saying: "I'm dying." The communication fell silent for an instant; Su Qingyao's voice suddenly turned urgent: "Where are you?" This reaction surprised Chen Ji—he had expected Su Qingyao to mock him or speak some grand empty words. But in her tone at this moment, there was clearly genuine concern.

"Control destiny with heart, lock heaven with life." Chen Ji repeated these eight words, a bold guess gradually forming in his heart. The Tianji Record granted him the ability to foresee the future, at the cost of consuming Heavenly Fate Value. And the reason the Eye of Heavenly Way wanted to erase him was precisely because his act of "peering into heavenly secrets" had offended this supreme existence. But what if he could reverse the operation—not peering into heavenly secrets, but using his own heavenly fate to "lock" something?

At that moment, the turtle shell suddenly vibrated violently. The light on its surface changed from faint glow to dazzling gold, and those originally dim ancient patterns now came alive, moving, intertwining, and reorganizing across the turtle shell. Chen Ji watched in amazement as a concave groove slowly emerged at the turtle shell's center—its shape was exactly identical to the mark on his chest! "This is..." Chen Ji drew a sharp breath, "Father foresaw all of this long ago?"

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice rang out again, this time carrying a barely perceptible tremor) "That turtle shell... impossible, how could it still have power? The Chen family ancestors clearly already..." For the first time, cracks appeared in the Eye of Heavenly Way's words. Chen Ji keenly caught this, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Afraid? Even the Eye of Heavenly Way can be afraid?" He gripped the turtle shell tightly in his hand, feeling the power surging within it. Although this power was faint, it was extraordinarily pure, as if his father had left him this final guardian across time and space.

text.content: The turtle shell grew warm in Chen Ji's palm, golden light flowing through his fingers into his body, clashing head-on with that crimson mark. For a moment, Chen Ji felt his body had become a battlefield of two wills—the Eye of Heavenly Way's erasure power on one side, frantically eroding his soul; the ancestral will sealed within the turtle shell on the other, guarding him with near stubbornness. Excruciating pain nearly drove Chen Ji to unconsciousness, yet he bit the tip of his tongue hard, forcing himself to remain清醒through pain.

"Three hours..." Chen Ji艰难露出一个笑容, blood flowing down the corner of his mouth, "You gave me three hours, and I will use these three hours... to turn your chess game upside down!" The moment these words fell, the turtle shell suddenly erupted with unprecedented light. That light was not an attack, but formed a cocoon, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. Under this cocoon's protection, the spread of the crimson mark noticeably slowed.

But Chen Ji knew this was only temporary. The power within the turtle shell was being consumed at a visible rate; at this trend, it could sustain him for at most one more hour. He must find the true method to break the deadlock before the power exhausted. He sat cross-legged on the cold ground of the Servants' Quarters, pressing the turtle shell against his brow center, attempting to communicate with the residual will within. Blurred images appeared again—he saw his father's youthful figure standing before a massive altar, holding the same turtle shell in his hand. Lying on the altar was a person, their face obscured by light, impossible to see clearly. But Chen Ji faintly heard his father say: "With my life, exchange for her sliver of survival... worth it."
